# Etobicoke Govee Light Installation

> Independent installer of Govee permanent outdoor lights, plus seasonal Christmas light installation (up before the holidays, down in the new year), for homes in Etobicoke, Toronto, Ontario. Plug-in lighting only: no electrical work, which in Ontario is for licensed electrical contractors. Not affiliated with, sponsored by or authorized by Govee.

- Phone: (647) 853-3571
- Email: etobicokelights@gmail.com
- Service area: Etobicoke, Toronto, ON

## Services

- [Permanent outdoor lights](https://etobicokelights.com/permanent-outdoor-lights/): Permanent outdoor lights installed on your Etobicoke roofline. Warm white every night, holiday colours from the app, nothing to take down. Get a quote.
- [Christmas light installation](https://etobicokelights.com/christmas-light-installation/): Christmas lights put up on your Etobicoke home before the holidays and taken down in the new year. Or go permanent with Govee lights. Get a quote.
- [Halloween lights](https://etobicokelights.com/halloween-lights/): Permanent Halloween lights for Etobicoke homes: orange, purple or green along the roofline in October, warm white the rest of the year. See our installs.
- [Diwali lights](https://etobicokelights.com/diwali-lights/): Diwali lights that stay up: permanent Govee lights along your Etobicoke roofline, bright and festive for Diwali, warm white the rest of the year.
- [Govee Pro installation](https://etobicokelights.com/govee-pro-installation/): Govee Permanent Outdoor Lights Pro installed in Etobicoke and cut to fit your roofline. Runs up to 200 ft, driver module past 150 ft. Get a quote.
- [Soffit lights](https://etobicokelights.com/soffit-lights/): Plug-in soffit lights tucked under your Etobicoke roof edge. Warm white every night, holiday colours from the app. No potlights, no wiring. Get a quote.
- [Outdoor lighting installation](https://etobicokelights.com/outdoor-lighting-installation/): Outdoor lighting installed on Etobicoke homes: rooflines, peaks, soffits, garages and corners. Plug-in Govee lighting, no wiring. Get a quote.
- [Outdoor lighting design](https://etobicokelights.com/outdoor-lighting-design/): Outdoor lighting design for Etobicoke homes: what to light, where the run starts and ends, Govee Lights 2 or Pro, and the colours you'll use all year.

## Guides

- [Can you cut Govee permanent outdoor lights? (length planner)](https://etobicokelights.com/can-you-cut-govee-permanent-outdoor-lights/): Depends on the model. The Govee Permanent Outdoor Lights 2 can't be cut; the Pro can, in runs up to 200 ft. See the lengths and plan your roofline.
